title: SPOT match schedule (data model v2)
description: An event's matches and its current match, one document per event (DV-14, D-4). Stored so a restart keeps them.

_id.description: The event id: one schedule per event.

tba.description: The last schedule read from The Blue Alliance (RT-22), or null if none was read.

manual.description: The schedule an admin typed. For each level that has typed matches, they are used instead of TBA's (AD-8, per level).

currentMatch.description: The match being scouted, chosen on the admin page (RT-16).

teamOrEmpty.description: A team key (DM-1a), or null for a slot not filled in yet.

level.description: Qualification or playoff; the match number counts within it (DV-17, RT-22a).

number.description: Within its level: qualification 1 to N, playoff 1 to 16 (RT-22a).

key.description: TBA's match key, such as 2026mnwi_qm12, or a made-up one for a manual match.

locked.description: A manual row an admin locked against accidental edits (AD-25a). Absent means unlocked.
